problem: A nonlinear system of ODEs has exactly two equilibrium points. The system is then shifted using the transformation $u=x-{x}^{∗},$ where ${x}^{∗}$ is one of the equilibria. Which of the following statements about the number of equilibria in the shifted system is guaranteed to be true?

choices.value: The shifted system has exactly one equilibrium point.
The shifted system has exactly three equilibrium points.
The shifted system has no equilibrium points.
The shifted system still has exactly two equilibrium points.
The shifted system has infinitely many equilibrium points.
